title: CANDIDATE: serve static-directory mount follows symlinks; via Funnel = unauthenticated internet arbitrary file read (sibling of Taildrive finding)
severity_estimate: Medium-High (internet-facing arbitrary file read as serving user), tempered: standard http.Dir behavior + requires owner to funnel-serve a directory containing an outward symlink
mechanism: http.Dir blocks '..' but os.Open follows symlinks; no EvalSymlinks/openat2 confinement. A directory serve mount reachable via funnelFlow (internet) therefore serves files a symlink inside the mount points to, outside the mount.
precondition: owner runs `tailscale serve <dir>` AND enables Funnel for that hostport AND a symlink to outside exists in the served tree.
relation: Same root cause class as the reported Taildrive webdav.Dir symlink escape (ev10); this variant is internet-facing (Funnel) rather than granted-peer.
status: candidate; pending funnel-agent corroboration and a decision on whether to fold into the Taildrive report as a second instance or report separately.
fix: confine serve file mounts to the mount root (EvalSymlinks within root / openat2 RESOLVE_BENEATH), same remediation as Taildrive.
